name: Progress MS-33
about: Progress MS-33 (2026-058A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2026 Mar 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2026 Mar 22), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
